reproduction: Symmetric second-gear coast; reverse rear evaluation order
explanation: Each scalar solve updates the other rear rotor through off-diagonal mobility, invalidating the preceding contact result.
frequency: Every coupled-contact tick; visible in straight coast
performanceImpact: More refinement cannot cure order bias
proposal: One consistent rear contact/clutch impulse contract
validation: Order reversal and mirror symmetry within rounding tolerance

symptom: New stalls at 2.50 and 3.97 s versus cornering branch
explanation: Changed engine braking interacts with existing contact/shaft dynamics; locally validated torque is not coupled validation.
proposal: Withhold promotion; reproduce phase-by-phase before calibrating
validation: No newly failing maneuver across 50–400 Hz

explanation: Normalization fixes force at the named scale, not its maximum; cap hides raw curve shape.
proposal: Define physical peak/stiffness contract and validate normalized curve
validation: Peak position, sign, slope and combined envelope over supported controls

explanation: Full plus two half solves at each recursion node, each up to 40 bisections and duplicate target objects.
proposal: Validated bounded solver with shared target evaluation and error contract

symptom: Nonzero heat at a holding static clutch
explanation: Free engine impulse followed by projection creates slip-work bookkeeping inconsistent with simultaneous static hold.
performanceImpact: Small direct cost; invalid energy model
proposal: Solve common-mode inertia and reaction at compatible time level

reproduction: Reverse slip with carried force; inspect prevTireForce
symptom: Delayed force can act along new patch motion
explanation: Force memory has no explicit recoverable-energy state or demonstrated bound. Positive instantaneous power alone is not proof of net creation.
proposal: Specify transient constitutive storage or a dissipative relaxation contract
validation: Closed slip cycles including storage and load changes

symptom: Large free-column excursions; current max yaw 1.409 rad/s
explanation: Previous-tick SAT plus 80 ms filter drives a small-inertia column; implicit viscous damping does not make delayed stiffness implicit.
performanceImpact: Secondary CPU cost, severe feedback effect
proposal: Time-aligned tire/column feedback, explicit trail/gear-ratio convention
validation: Passive fixed-rack/released-column experiments and frequency sweep

explanation: Unconditional radial velocity kick lacks approach test and physical mass/reaction; executes after derived-state update.
frequency: Only balloon overlaps; cannot explain balloon-free failures
performanceImpact: Effect spawning can add render cost
proposal: Move explicit collision impulse to mechanical boundary with contact contract
validation: Separating contact must not inject energy; derived caches coherent

symptom: Yaw decay and threshold sleep remove energy
explanation: Explicit yaw damping and sleep thresholds are intentional empirical interventions, not solved tire physics.
proposal: Expose work ledger and rationale; retain until replacement verified
validation: Undamped free-motion and controlled stop tests

symptom: Loads derive from lagged chassis acceleration
explanation: 1 ms suspension substeps hold prior chassis acceleration; tire reaction is not fed back within the tick.
proposal: Partition contract with averaged loads, event handling and exchange work

symptom: About 38 Nm full-load target at 800 RPM; gentle launch fails
explanation: Inherited synthetic brake curve and guessed losses/inertia do not identify a real engine. Calibration gap, not dimensional error.
proposal: Identify reference engine and map after coupling is trustworthy
validation: Rundown and loaded launches against measured target

explanation: Recovery threshold above loss threshold; per-tick EMA changes with Hz. wheelGrip is assigned opposite meanings then overwritten.
performanceImpact: Events/effects may churn; not proven dominant
proposal: Correct diagnostic contract separately from force calibration

symptom: Multi-ms tire ticks plus rendering exceed high-refresh frame budgets
explanation: Up to six catch-up ticks share main thread; excess backlog is dropped; 250 ms wall-time clamp hides longer stalls.
proposal: Bound physics/render cost and retain time-drop telemetry
validation: Real RAF/input tests on target browser and display

reproduction: head-on ledger; oblique sweep still required
symptom: Per-corner reflection followed by projection is not a general rigid contact solve
explanation: Restitution/friction/contact manifold not unified; head-on test dissipates energy and does not establish oblique validity.
proposal: Rigid contact manifold and collision energy contract if failures reproduced
validation: Oblique/corner contacts with momentum and restitution ledger

reproduction: software WebGPU smoke; user RTX 5090 unavailable
symptom: User-specific severe FPS/device-import problems not reproduced on hardware
explanation: CPU render submission timing is not GPU completion/presentation timing.
proposal: Collect target-machine trace and adapter/backend info
validation: 60/120/240 physical displays, resolution/DPR sweep and GPU timestamps

symptom: Unused displacement clamp and chassis brake helper remain exported
explanation: Names/comments imply active mechanisms; main uses wheel brakes and no displacement clamp.
